void-plum.$description: Void Plum — Page canvas and primary dark surface — the near-black violet base that absorbs the whole immersive hero and footer bands

eclipse-black.$description: Eclipse Black — Elevated card and panel surface — one shade deeper than the canvas, used for floating UI elements against the dark backdrop

carbon-ink.$description: Carbon Ink — Badge fills, icon stroke accents, and dark section surfaces on lighter contexts

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Dominant border and divider color across the entire system — every hairline, card edge, and UI outline uses this muted purple-gray

ghost-violet.$description: Ghost Violet — Muted helper text and low-priority iconography — the quietest of the violet-tinged grays

ash-wisp.$description: Ash Wisp — Secondary body text and metadata labels against the dark canvas

silver-smoke.$description: Silver Smoke — Tertiary text, inactive nav items, and icon fills at low emphasis

moonstone.$description: Moonstone — Mid-priority text, generic icon strokes, and light-section muted copy

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Primary text on dark surfaces, light section backgrounds, and the brightest highlight color

bone.$description: Bone — Warm off-white for light content section backgrounds — subtly cream against the pure white of inner cards

frost.$description: Frost — Surface fill for nested elements and subtle dividers in light sections

laser-violet.$description: Laser Violet — Primary action button fill, focus rings, and the brand's signature accent — vivid electric purple against the dark void creates urgency without aggression

royal-plum.$description: Royal Plum — Decorative stroke accent for gradient mesh backgrounds and atmospheric purple lighting

merlot-shadow.$description: Merlot Shadow — Deep heading color and surface tint for accent cards in light sections

mulberry-deep.$description: Mulberry Deep — Dark section heading color and dramatic text accent in light-mode areas

coral-spark.$description: Coral Spark — Warm secondary accent for highlights, callout dots, and emphasis on light surfaces

uncut-sans-variable.$description: Primary brand typeface — geometric sans with wide optical width, used for all display headlines, body copy, nav, buttons, and card content. The tight negative letter-spacing at large sizes (-0.05em at 50px = -2.5px) gives display text a confident, compressed feel; the positive 0.08em at small caps creates wide-tracked eyebrow labels.

martian-mono.$description: Technical metadata and dimensional annotations — dimension labels, coordinates, file names, and small UI labels that benefit from a monospaced signature. The 0.05em positive tracking gives it a delicate, architect-blueprint quality.

inter.$description: Secondary system font used in tertiary UI elements, icons-adjacent labels, and fallback roles where Uncut Sans is not needed. Covers the smallest sizes (8–12px) with clean legibility.
